title: Rebate Exhibit to the PBM Services Agreement
content:
This exhibit states, for each pricing arrangement of the PBM Services Agreement, the share of manufacturer rebates passed to the plan sponsor, the minimum rebates guaranteed per prescription, the conditions attached to those guarantees, and the payment timetable and offset election for rebates.

## A. Pass-through share and per-prescription guarantees

The pass-through share is the share of manufacturer rebates passed to the sponsor. Each guarantee is a minimum rebate in USD per prescription of the stated class; a guarantee of 0.00 means the arrangement carries no guarantee for that class.

| Pricing arrangement | Rebate pass-through share | Guarantee per brand retail prescription (USD) | Guarantee per brand home delivery prescription (USD) | Guarantee per specialty prescription (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 85% | 150.00 | 400.00 | 900.00 |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 100% | 0.00 (none) | 0.00 (none) | 0.00 (none) |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 100% | 0.00 (none) | 0.00 (none) | 0.00 (none) |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 100% | 245.00 | 640.00 | 1450.00 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 100% | 265.00 | 690.00 | 1600.00 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 100% | 280.00 | 720.00 | 1700.00 |

## B. Conditions attached to the guarantees

The guarantee formularies are the formularies the sponsor's members must be on for the rebate guarantee to apply. The exclusive specialty requirement states whether the pricing arrangement requires members to be on an exclusive specialty program.

| Pricing arrangement | Guarantee formularies | Exclusive specialty program required |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, Northbridge Value Formulary, Northbridge Standard Formulary, Northbridge Preferred Drug List | No |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | none listed (no guarantee) | No |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | none listed (no guarantee) | No |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, Northbridge Value Formulary, Northbridge Standard Formulary, Northbridge Preferred Drug List | Yes |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, Northbridge Value Formulary, Northbridge Standard Formulary | Yes |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, Northbridge Value Formulary | No |

## C. Payment timetable and offset election

Payment lag is the number of calendar days after a calendar quarter ends within which that quarter's rebates are paid. True-up timing is the number of calendar days after the contract year ends within which the annual rebate guarantee true-up is paid. The offset election, where available, lets the sponsor apply a rebate payment as a credit against open invoices.

| Pricing arrangement | Payment frequency | Payment lag (calendar days after quarter end) | Guarantee true-up (calendar days after contract year end) | Offset election available |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | quarterly | 180 | 270 | Yes |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | quarterly | 150 | 240 | Yes |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | quarterly | 150 | 240 | Yes |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | quarterly | 120 | 210 | Yes |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | quarterly | 90 | 180 | Yes |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | quarterly | 90 | 180 | Yes |

## Reading notes

- Every arrangement pays rebates quarterly and allows the offset election; the arrangements differ in how quickly a quarter is paid and how quickly the true-up follows the contract year.
- Northbridge Traditional Pricing is the only arrangement that passes through less than the full manufacturer rebate (85%) while still carrying per-prescription guarantees.
